profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Anduril Industries
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a Masters in Computer Science and 10 years of experience, including over 9 years of experience in the AR/VR space.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Meta Reality Labs Research - Systems and Sensors Research (contract via ICONMA)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Mixed Reality
positions.description:
- Contributed to the OpenXR runtime on Android, enabling cross-platform Unity mixed reality apps on next-generation devices. 
- Prototyped on-device Copilot and spatial AI experiences for HoloLens, and shipped features for the in-market device.

positions.title: Software Engineer — Software Products and Capabilities
positions.description:
- Proposed and led a 5-engineer team building a 3D interface for next-generation helmet-mounted displays. 
- Built a real-time cockpit display application in OpenGL/C++, including a safety-critical variant.

positions.title: Software Engineer - F-15 Advance Technology and Concepts
positions.description:
- Co-led an R&D initiative with 15+ cross-functional engineers on advanced aircraft technology. 
- Product Owner for a team integrating a C++/OpenGL display framework onto an aircraft platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer - F-15 Mission Systems
positions.description:
- Integrated new avionics systems into aircraft operating system software. 
- Built AR/VR applications on HoloLens, Magic Leap, desktop VR, and iOS, and demonstrated them to customers and government stakeholders.
